tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// gshin rje khro chu dug gdong nag po'i zhal gdams gces gnad yang gab sbas

pa'i rgya can bzhugs so// gshin rje khro chu dug gdong gi las sbyor liṅga'i sngags kyi man ngag ni/ dug gsum gnad 'bebs bsad pa'i liṅga dang mnan gtad kyi liṅga rnams kyi tha mar sngags gsum gyi mthar/ nṛ dzaḥtri baṃ ril dzaḥ ā karṣa ya dzaḥgarbaha nṛ dzaḥ che ge mo'i bla sha re ma ti 'grim 'grib sha ma ru tri thul thul myog myog yed yed sha ma ru tri khug ling myog ling sha ling thuṃ tsa muṇḍi bhyo dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes bla 'gugs dang de'i mthar sarba duṣṭāṃ dgra bo che ge mo'i srog rtsa la myog myog yaṃ yaṃ rbad rbad la li tha ba ni rā tsa pra ba ni dgra bo che ge mo'i srog snying la nṛ mā ra ya rbad/ dgra bo che ge mo'i srog la myag myag kṛṣṭa mā ra ya rbad rbad dza dzaḥsha khaṃ khaṃ ma srog tsitta tsitta rbad rbad snying tsitta ma ma dum bu kha ling rbad rbad ru ni ma ru yaksha rbad rbad nṛ gha garbaha ma sha yaṃ gtubs gtubs rbad rbad srog tsitta ya ma dun bhyoḥrā tri ru tri rbad rbad sha tsitta srog dum bu kha la yaṃ/ yaksha rbad rbad kha la dum bu srog la rbad rbad ma du ya rbad rbad/ ya ma rā dza dgra bo che ge mo'i srog la khrag thig snying phyung dgra bo che ge mo'i srog la shag rbad sho na ma ri raksha kha thaṃ dgra bo che ge mo'i srog rtsa la sha dzaḥ rtsa khrag tsitta phyung dgra bo che ge mo'i srog la thuṃ ril dzaḥdagra bo che ge mo thuṃ ril rbad dgra bo che mo'i srog breng shag rbad/ ya ma ka la sha la dzaḥbhyo snying kha rakmo dgra bo che mo'i srog la thun nag po tsitta dgra bo che ge mo'i srog la thun: ya ma rā dza dgra bo che ge mo'i snying la thun: ya kṛ ni dgra bo che ge mo'i dbugs la thun: ha shad ya ma rā dza snying sbub hab shad snying kha rakmo rā tsa dgra bo che ge mo'i dbugs la thun: snying khrag shab long thun thun bhyo bhyoḥ zhes dang de'i mthar dgra bo che ge mo lha srung dang bcas pa'i srog la myog myog yaṃ yaṃ rbad rbad la li tha ba ni sogs las byang nas bshad pa'i bsad sngags dang*/

de'i mthar dgra bo che ge mo'i rtsa drug ta thun ta sha ku ru sogs zhal gdams shog dril du bshad pa'i thun sngags dang*/ de'i mthar dgra bo che ge mo ma rig pa'i smag rum du phob cig /rga shi rten dang phrol zhig /skye ba'i dbang po sdoms shig /srod pa'i mnga' phung chom zhig /len pa'i mdangs phrogs shig /srid pa'i tshang shig cig /tshor ba mya ngan du phob cig /reg pa'i khung phyung zhig /skye mched drug 'gag tu chug cig /ming dang gzugs phrog cig /rnam shes rten dang phrol cig /'du byed skyengs su chug cig /ces bri/ de'i mthar dug gsum khros pa bsad 'khor la bsad pa'i dmod bcol btags pa mgo nang du bltas la bskor/ mnan pa la gong gi mthar dgra bo che ge mo sa khams nan sogs btags pa mgo phyir bltas bskor/ gtad la gong gi mthar g.yas skor mgo nang bltas su oṃ nag po ti pa tsa sogs dang*/ g.yon skor mgo phyir bltas su nā ga gur ling gis bskor gnyis ka'i mthar gtad kyi sham bu btags/ zhal gdams shog dril dang dpe chung rnams su rang rang gi sngags ma gtogs med pa ni gab cing sbas pa yin pas lag len nyams su blang ba'i tshe liṅga'i mthar sngags bkod lugs 'di kho na ltar byed dgos rgyu yin no// ces pa sngags 'chang chos kyi grags pas zab khol gab sbas su phyung ba yin no// rang gi slob ma snying 'dra ba dam tshig srung nges ma gtogs pa gang thod thod du bstan na las kyi gshin rjes chad pa myur du chod cig// /sa ma ya/ rgya rgya rgya// gambhīr guptaḥ
